mira_sales: Heads up 1: MerchantOne ready to sign commit. They want sustained 5k RPS for campaign windows, 2x short bursts, and 200ms p95. Asking for reserved GPUs + burst credits pricing. Can eng confirm resource plan + autoscale rules?

raj_sre: Quick clarifying q  is 5k RPS single-turn generation or multi-turn? avg tokens?

mira_sales: Mostly single-turn chat, avg 350 tokens, rerank ~8%.

ana_prod: With seq~350 and strict 200ms p95 cap (so batching queue << model latency), expect ~800 rps per A100-equiv GPU. That gives ~7 GPUs reserved. With KV cache warm we can get +25% effective throughput.

leo_infra: To support 2x 10min bursts, add a burst pool of ~6 GPUs. Recommend spot for cost, but document eviction fallback to quantized 8-bit variant.

sam_se: Security asks? CMEK, VPC, audit retention? Private deploy?

mira_sales: Yes, MerchantOne needs CMEK, VPC peering, 12mo audit logs, SOC2 addendum.

sam_se: We support CMEK and VPC for Private. Audit logs can export to their S3. SOC2 addendum needs legal ~5 business days. No technical blockers.

raj_sre: Autoscale draft: watch 30s RPS avg, scale up when >80% of reserved for 60s, cooldown 120s, allow burst pool until max. If burst not ready within 120s, fallback to quantized model; if still constrained respond 429s. Notify via webhook.

ana_prod: Add preheat: kick KV warmup 10m before campaign using preheat API. Avoid scaling into cold KV.

leo_infra: Preheat example: `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood/v1/preheat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"job":"kv_warm","model":"merchant-chat-v1","start_in":"10m","duration_mins":15}'`

mira_sales: Legal asked for SLA blurb for contract. Anyone draftable now?

raj_sre: Draft SLA line: "Reserved capacity guaranteed per schedule. Burst credits are best-effort; if burst capacity cannot be provisioned within 120s Redwood will attempt an automated fallback to a quantized model variant. Continued constraint may result in HTTP 429s; credits apply per contract."

sam_se: Also recommend pinning model checkouts and quantization profile in contract to avoid perf regressions.

ana_prod: Observability: will create per-tenant dashboard with token-level cost, per-route latency, KV hit-rate, coldstart rate. Alert: p95>200ms for 2 consecutive 5-min windows -> page oncall.

mira_sales: Action items: (1) @ana_prod perf table + conservative GPU counts by EOD. (2) @leo_infra runbook + preheat sample. (3) @sam_se security checklist and SOC2 timeline. (4) @raj_sre SLA blurb & 429 policy. I'll bundle for finance/legal.

notify_bot: Note: Dedicated provisioning requires RFC ticket and AZ affinity. Link: https://rfd.redwood.example/reqs/9980
